entities.name: Ivan III & the 'Third Rome'
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Ivan III ('the Great') ended Mongol suzerainty (1480), married the Byzantine princess Sophia Palaiologina, adopted the double-headed eagle, rebuilt the Moscow Kremlin, and proclaimed Moscow the 'Third Rome' — successor to Rome and Constantinople.
